after.zh: 求坡度去掉了整体加亮（偏置），除以最陡的坡度去掉了整体倍数（增益）。设计特征时先问：哪些变化不应该改变答案？这叫不变性。注意图外补的数：补 0 会在图边造出一条随灯光变化的假边，所以要复制边缘。
after.en: Taking slopes removes an overall brightening (the offset); dividing by the steepest slope removes an overall scaling (the gain). When you design a feature, first ask: which changes should not change the answer? This is called invariance. Mind the padding outside the image: padding with 0 creates a fake edge at the border that changes with the lighting, so replicate the edge instead.

t.zh: 找边还差一步：定一个门槛，梯度超过它的像素才算边。门槛太低，表面的细纹也算进来；太高，真正的边又会漏掉。
t.en: Finding edges needs one more step: a threshold, so that only pixels whose gradient exceeds it count as edges. Too low, and fine texture counts too; too high, and real edges are missed.

t.zh: 麻烦在灯光。车上的摄像头中午和傍晚都要认出同一条路沿，不可能每换一次光就重调一次门槛。同一张脸在室内和室外，像素数值差得很远，该给的答案却一样。
t.en: The trouble is lighting. A car's camera must recognise the same kerb at noon and at dusk; it cannot retune the threshold every time the light changes. The same face indoors and outdoors gives very different pixel values, yet the answer should be the same.

caption.zh: 同一个 F，灯暗了，期望的边不变
caption.en: The same F with a dimmer lamp: the expected edges stay the same

t.zh: 这一关新出现的元件是<part-ref to="part:globalMax"></part-ref>：找出输入里最大的那个数，输出一张处处都是这个数的图。
t.en: New in this level is the part <part-ref to="part:globalMax"></part-ref>: it finds the largest number in its input and outputs a picture filled with that number everywhere.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：输入是同一个物体在不同灯光下的照片，有的整体变亮，有的变暗。输出它的边，四组测试的期望完全一样。
t.en: Your task in this level: the inputs are photos of the same object under different lighting, some brighter overall, some dimmer. Output its edges; all four tests expect exactly the same answer.

caption.zh: 第一组测试：原来的灯光 → 期望

brief.zh: 同一个物体在不同灯光下拍了几次：有的整体变亮，有的灯暗了一半。每次都要标出同一组边：梯度大小超过这张图里最陡处一半的像素输出 1。
brief.en: The same object was photographed several times under different lighting: in some shots it is brighter overall, in others the light is half as strong. Each time, mark the same set of edges: output 1 at pixels whose gradient magnitude is more than half that of the steepest spot in the picture.

hint.zh: 不知道灯暗了多少，能不能在图里找一把跟着灯光一起变长变短的尺子？
hint.en: You don't know how much the light dimmed. Can you find a ruler inside the image that grows and shrinks with the light?
